snippet.title: HOMS Marking Relief Pack: Send the batch, rubric, memo, and marksheet. Get structured marking suppor
snippet.description:
HOMS Marking Relief Pack is part of the KnowEdge AutoRelease Suite.

Buyer: Lecturers, teachers, markers, tutors, and academic departments
Pain: Marking backlogs drain time, consistency, and useful feedback quality.
Promise: Draft feedback, annotated files where possible, rubric documents, marks CSV, and lecturer review summary.

CTA: Send one fake or non-sensitive batch to prove the workflow.

This is a review-first workflow. Human approval remains required.
